findings.title: get_monitor_environment_context mutates a config copy but returns the original
findings.body: In get_monitor_environment_context, the function copies monitor_environment.monitor.config into a local variable `config` and replaces `config['schedule_type']` with the human-readable display string, but the returned dict contains `"config": monitor_environment.monitor.config` — the original, unmodified config. The copy-and-mutate code is therefore dead, and every monitor incident occurrence event still carries the raw integer `schedule_type` in its monitor context instead of the intended display value. This defect was carried over unchanged from the old mark_failed.py location, but since the code is being moved wholesale it is worth fixing now by returning the modified `config` (or deleting the dead copy if the raw value is intentional).
